title: Tool Over-Temperature
fullDescription: Skil PWRCore tools blink one LED when motor or driver thermal protection trips.

title: Stall / Over-Current
fullDescription: Two blinks indicate motor protection tripped from stall.

title: Battery Low Cutoff
fullDescription: Three blinks indicate the pack reached protective discharge limit.

title: Battery Over-Temperature
fullDescription: Four blinks indicate PWRCore pack temperature above limit.

title: Battery Communication Error
fullDescription: Five blinks indicate handshake failure - dirty contacts most common cause.

title: Charger Defective Pack
fullDescription: Solid red on PWRJump indicates BMS lockout or cell failure.

title: Charger Temperature Hold
shortDescription: Pack out of charging temperature window.
fullDescription: Red blink waits for pack to enter 0-45 C charging window. PWRJump's active cooling speeds recovery.

title: Driver Stage Fault
fullDescription: Six blinks indicate the brushless driver detected an internal short or open.

title: Tool Will Not Power On
fullDescription: Dead tool typically points to terminal damage or controller failure.

fixSteps.title: Inspect terminals
fixSteps.instruction: Look in tool foot for bent contacts.

title: Trigger Stuck or Erratic
fullDescription: Wood dust packs around the trigger and prevents return spring action.
